name: ef_nox_n
source: EEA 2023 3.D Table 3-1: 0.04 kg NO2/kg fertiliser and manure N applied (note a: NO reported as NO2; Skiba et al. 2021; 95 % CI 0.005-0.104; same value as EEA 2016, decision L39) * 14/46. Deviation from Quantis 2019 (0.04*14/30)

name: legume_uptake_share
source: Schmid et al. 2000, cited in WFLDB Guidelines v3.0 (2016) section 3.9.7.2: legumes count 40 % of the N uptake, the rest is fixed from the air. Since decision L30 applied to the default N uptake of the crops with legume = yes in crop_types.csv, hence also to their default mineral N and manure

name: p_drainage_factor
source: Prasuhn 2006; Nemecek et al. 2023 ESM5 (SALCAfieldP) Eq. 5

name: p_runoff_slope_threshold_pct
source: Prasuhn 2006; Nemecek et al. 2023 ESM5 (SALCAfieldP) Eq. 2, factor s

name: p_corr_slurry_leaching
source: Prasuhn 2006 via Quantis 2019: Fgw = 1 + 0.2/80 x P2O5 slurry

name: p_corr_mineral_runoff
source: Prasuhn 2006 via Quantis 2019: Fro term 0.2/80 x P2O5 mineral

name: p_corr_slurry_runoff
source: Prasuhn 2006 via Quantis 2019: Fro term 0.7/80 x P2O5 slurry or liquid sludge

name: p_corr_manure_runoff
source: Prasuhn 2006 via Quantis 2019: Fro term 0.4/80 x P2O5 solid manure

name: liquid_manure_density_kg_per_m3
source: Derived by FC (2026-10-12) from the general comment of the ecoinvent v3.12 dataset "manure, liquid, cattle" (Recycled Content cut-off), which reports 7.5 % dry matter; replaces the legacy 1006 kg/m3 (decision L18)

name: hm_pesticide_harvest_export_fraction
source: Audsley et al. (1997) via SALCAheavymetal V1.0 (Nemecek et al. 2023, Appendix 7) Eq. 4, A_p: fraction of the metals of pesticides exported with the harvest

name: mineral_n_share_of_n_uptake
unit: kg N mineral / kg N uptake
source: WFLDB Guidelines v3.0 (2016) section 3.6.2: ratio of N applied as mineral fertilisers to total N = 0.8 for all crops and countries (L0); total N input = N uptake (section 3.6.1). Decision L28; 1 - this share = available N of the default manure (L29); (1 - this share) / this share x default mineral N = available N of the default manure of the crops without level 1 coefficients (L40)

name: tree_crop_residues_kg_fm_per_ha
source: Residues of the tree crops counted in the WFLDB L1 N input (Guidelines v3.0 section 3.6.1), with the N content of haulm or stem of the WFLDB Background Parameters 2017 sheet 4 (3.1 g N/kg FM for all tree crops). Derived (decision L32): GD_crop Nuptake_L1 = yield x N of the main product + 18.6 kg N/ha (6000 kg x 3.1 g/kg) for the 15 tree crops in all their countries, and the rule reproduces the WFLDB 3.1 datasets with N at L1 (Documentation 2017 Excel annex sheet 2c: coconut PH, lemon MX, tea KE and LK, pear BE). The amount is not stated in the WFLDB reports; legacy, undocumented, provisional

name: irrigation_efficiency_surface
source: WFLDB Guidelines v3.0 (2016) section 3.5.2 Tab. 3 (adapted from FAO 1989): irrigation efficiency factor EFirr = field application efficiency Ea 0.60 x conveyance efficiency Ec 0.75. Water withdrawal = ETirr / EFirr. Decision L44 (was hardcoded in irrigationmodel.py and defaultGeneration.py)

name: irrigation_efficiency_sprinkler
source: WFLDB Guidelines v3.0 (2016) section 3.5.2 Tab. 3 (adapted from FAO 1989): EFirr = Ea 0.75 x Ec 1.00. Decision L44

name: irrigation_efficiency_localized
source: WFLDB Guidelines v3.0 (2016) section 3.5.2 Tab. 3 (adapted from FAO 1989), drip irrigation: EFirr = Ea 0.90 x Ec 1.00; applied to AQUASTAT 'localized irrigation'. Decision L44
